Future native source changes require a NEW actually accepted source version/input/private-project provenance, receipt/marker/stamp/current_files/module hashes and fresh gateway process. Update and independently review Root caller expected-current tuple and source pins against that actual accepted version; never silently retain222/private525/b9bb/6ce/466c67/648579 pins or relabel new F04 as oldv04. Unchanged evidence can be reused only with verified matching bytes/dependencies.

Before ONCE/issuer/Runner.new/clock, hard readiness verifies the actual installed typed F04 API and ingress/stop/terminal schema capability plus fresh Root current/permissions/cancel/source/private-exclusion/semantic nonreplay/slot/resources/CAS facts.
